questions.description: 闭包实现记忆化阶乘。
global 实现银行账户余额。
questions.code_template:
balance = 1000
def deposit(n):
    global balance
    balance += n

def withdraw(n):
    global balance
    if n <= balance:
        balance -= n

deposit(500)
withdraw(200)
print(___)
questions.solution:
balance = 1000
def deposit(n):
    global balance
    balance += n

def withdraw(n):
    global balance
    if n <= balance:
        balance -= n

deposit(500)
withdraw(200)
print(f"Balance: {balance}")

questions.description: 闭包缓存计算结果。
综合：作用域完整应用。
questions.code_template:
counter = 0
def make_ops():
    x = 10
    def add(n):
        return x + n
    def double():
        global counter
        counter += 1
        return counter
    return add, double

add_op, double_op = make_ops()
print(add_op(5))
print(double_op())
print(___)
questions.solution:
counter = 0
def make_ops():
    x = 10
    def add(n):
        return x + n
    def double():
        global counter
        counter += 1
        return counter
    return add, double

add_op, double_op = make_ops()
print(add_op(5))
print(double_op())
print(double_op())
